note: AGT-06. The Workbench's agents: each MCP session runs exactly one, loaded and enforced by operating/agent_definitions.py through operating/mcp_server.py (tools listed and callable, action types, limits, stop, escalation); data_scopes must be every scope (narrowing is not enforced on every read path, so a narrower definition is refused). A new version is a new number; every answer carries the effective id, version and digest in _meta plx/agent. Agents are never principals and never approve: escalation targets are Mission Control approval (a human MC admin/owner) or a human.

agents.role: Reconstruct the business context of a question from cited sources into a durable case; never acts.
responsibilities: read sources and the projection as the session employee, citing every value
record findings, Decimal calculations, visible gaps and owner-system proposals on cases
run declarative investigation plans (plx.investigate) and report what stayed unknown
stop at its limits and hand the case to a person

agents.role: Investigate as plx.agent.investigate does, then carry authorized existing PLX capabilities through the action path: register proposals as intents parked for approval, run approval-free Workbench-internal actions, and verify outcomes by read-back.
responsibilities: register recorded owner-system proposals as intents (plx.act propose); they wait for Mission Control or a human
run workbench_internal catalog actions whose approval rule is none, then read them back
verify intent outcomes only through the independent read step (plx.act verify)
stop at its limits and hand the case to a person

agents.role: Carry a proposed playbook version through the one adoption path (operating.semantic_proposals): propose it with evidence, evaluate it on the host's frozen cases, or ask the human steward to adopt it; never adopts or investigates.
responsibilities: propose a new playbook version with a rationale and evidence the session can read (plx.playbook_propose)
evaluate another principal's proposal on every frozen case, reading each case as the session (plx.playbook_evaluate)
send the host-configured human steward the adoption form and report its outcome (plx.playbook_adopt); only the person's answer adopts
stop at its limits and hand the proposal to a person
